question: Should maintainers continue repairing this broad external Signal quote branch, or consolidate native Signal quote support under https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95718 and the narrower BodyForAgent follow-up?
rationale: The PR overlaps an active maintainer-labeled Signal quote implementation, changes public plugin SDK semantics, and still has proof and correctness blockers that automation cannot resolve without choosing the intended product/API direction.

options.title: Consolidate under the maintainer Signal quote path
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95718 as the native quote implementation path, reconcile any remaining BodyForAgent behavior through the narrow related issue/PR, and close this broad branch once maintainers agree no unique part should be preserved.

options.title: Keep repairing this branch
options.body: Require the contributor or a maintainer to fix the BodyForAgent and public SDK blockers, resolve conflicts, and add redacted live Signal proof before any merge review.

options.title: Pause until overlap is resolved
options.body: Leave this PR open but inactive until the maintainer-owned quote direction lands or is rejected, then re-check whether any unique explicit-reply behavior remains.

recommendation.title: Consolidate under the maintainer Signal quote path
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95718 as the native quote implementation path, reconcile any remaining BodyForAgent behavior through the narrow related issue/PR, and close this broad branch once maintainers agree no unique part should be preserved.

likelyOwner.reason: jesse-merhi owns the overlapping maintainer-labeled Signal native quote PR and is the clearest available owner for choosing the canonical Signal quote direction.
